fields.description:
## Context / Problem
Every rebar LLM operation (review-plan, verify-completion, gated close) fails with "no AWS region could be resolved" in any shell where only AWS_REGION is exported — the standard region variable modern AWS tooling sets (CLI v2 docs, SDKs) and what operators export in their shell profiles. Observed 2026-08-14: a login shell exports AWS_REGION=us-west-2; every subagent/tool shell inherits it; rebar's bedrock provider still refuses to run until REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION or AWS_DEFAULT_REGION is manually injected per command.

Root cause: `build_bedrock_provider` (src/rebar/llm/bedrock_model.py:99) passes only `cfg.bedrock_region_name` to `boto3.session.Session(region_name=...)` and otherwise delegates region resolution entirely to botocore, and botocore 1.43.62 does not consult AWS_REGION (measured; pinned by tests/unit/test_bedrock_provider.py:704 `test_aws_region_alone_resolves_nothing_and_still_raises`). Effective order today: REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION -> AWS_DEFAULT_REGION (via botocore) -> profile config; AWS_REGION is never consulted. The error message (bedrock_model.py:110-118) documents the trap in a long "AWS_REGION alone does NOT resolve" paragraph instead of closing it. Correction to this plan's earlier draft: provider provenance records NO region today for ANY source — `provenance_for` (src/rebar/llm/capabilities.py:554) has no region field, so this fix ADDS region recording rather than extending an existing one.

## Approach
Close the trap in rebar's own layer instead of waiting on botocore: a small pure resolver plus an explicit `region_name=` to the boto3 session makes botocore's AWS_REGION quirk irrelevant, preserves the no-invented-default-region policy, and gives provenance one source of truth.

1. New pure function `resolve_bedrock_region(bedrock_region_name: str | None) -> tuple[str | None, str | None]` in src/rebar/llm/bedrock_model.py returning `(region, source)`. Chain and the EXACT `source` string returned (and recorded verbatim as `region_source`): configured `bedrock_region_name` (REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION / `[tool.rebar.llm].bedrock_region_name`) -> `"REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION"`; env AWS_DEFAULT_REGION -> `"AWS_DEFAULT_REGION"`; env AWS_REGION -> `"AWS_REGION"`; nothing set -> `(None, None)`, meaning boto3's own resolution (active profile) applies, unchanged. Worked example: with AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=eu-west-1 and AWS_REGION=us-west-2 both set and no rebar knob, the resolver returns `("eu-west-1", "AWS_DEFAULT_REGION")`. Empty-string env values are treated as unset (botocore parity).
2. `build_bedrock_provider` calls it and passes the resolved region explicitly to `boto3.session.Session(region_name=...)`. The existing no-region LLMConfigError precheck stays, but its message is rewritten to name the full chain (REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION > AWS_DEFAULT_REGION > AWS_REGION > profile) and DROP the now-moot AWS_REGION-does-not-work paragraph; the IMDS note stays. Docstring MEASURED paragraphs are updated the same way.
3. Provenance: `provenance_for` (src/rebar/llm/capabilities.py:554) gains an optional `bedrock_region_name` kwarg; when `provider == "bedrock"` it calls `resolve_bedrock_region` (lazy import; pure and stdlib-only — no boto3 enters this signed-record path) and, when the chain resolves, records additive keys `region` + `region_source` in `provider_provenance`. Both keys are absent when boto3's ambient profile resolution applies — rebar cannot observe that value at this seam without importing boto3, and synthesising it would place an unverified fact into a signed record (same rule as `endpoint_host`). The runner call site (src/rebar/llm/runner.py:450) threads `bedrock_region_name=cfg.bedrock_region_name` (+1 line; runner.py is 796 lines against the 800 cap — verified it fits, and no new branch lands there so the C901 ratchet is untouched).
4. Docs: docs/llm-framework.md:191-197 region bullet + :390 env-table row, docs/local-dev-env.md:288 region bullet. Infra runbooks keep their dated MEASURED records (historical evidence, still true of botocore).

Riskiest assumption: passing `region_name=` explicitly bypasses botocore's AWS_REGION quirk. Cheapest falsifier first: the spy-session mechanism already proves `Session(region_name=...)` reaches the client (tests/unit/test_bedrock_provider.py:773), and the new AWS_REGION-alone test is written RED-first against current behavior before any src change.

## Scope
- src/rebar/llm/bedrock_model.py — resolver, explicit region_name, new error text, docstrings
- src/rebar/llm/capabilities.py — provenance_for records region + region_source
- src/rebar/llm/runner.py — thread cfg.bedrock_region_name into provenance_for (+1 line)
- tests/unit/test_bedrock_provider.py — precedence test, AWS_REGION-alone-now-works (rewrites the 4e71 oracle at :704, which pins the old raise), error-message assertions
- tests/unit/test_verdict_provenance.py — region/region_source recording + absence cases
- docs/llm-framework.md, docs/local-dev-env.md — region guidance

## Testing
Withheld-oracle TDD: each new test is written and shown RED against the unfixed tree first.
- Happy path: with only AWS_REGION=us-west-2 (AWS_DEFAULT_REGION and REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION unset; spy boto3 session), `build_bedrock_provider` builds and the session receives `region_name="us-west-2"` (checked via the existing `_spy_boto_session` recorder).
- Precedence: one test sets all three sources to distinct regions and strips them pairwise, pinning REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION beats AWS_DEFAULT_REGION beats AWS_REGION.
- Failure path: no region anywhere still raises LLMConfigError; the message names all of REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION, AWS_DEFAULT_REGION, AWS_REGION, and no longer contains the stale "does NOT resolve" guidance (asserted on the message).
- Provenance: `provenance_for(provider="bedrock", ...)` records region + region_source per source; both keys absent for non-bedrock providers and when nothing in rebar's chain resolves.
- Ambient-profile fallback: the existing `test_an_ambient_boto3_region_is_still_honoured` stays green (no invented default).
- Mutation testing on `resolve_bedrock_region` (hand-mutants: reorder the chain, drop a var, invert empty-string handling, swap a source label); kill rate reported as a ticket comment.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] With only AWS_REGION set, `build_bedrock_provider` resolves that region and passes it explicitly to the boto3 session; checked by the new spy-session unit test in tests/unit/test_bedrock_provider.py.
- [ ] Resolution order pinned by a passing precedence test: REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION > AWS_DEFAULT_REGION > AWS_REGION > profile fallback (ambient-profile test still green).
- [ ] Resolved region + region_source recorded in `provider_provenance` for bedrock runs when rebar's chain resolves; absent otherwise; checked by new tests in tests/unit/test_verdict_provenance.py.
- [ ] The no-region error message names the full chain and the stale AWS_REGION warning is gone (message-assertion test); docs/llm-framework.md and docs/local-dev-env.md region guidance updated to match.
- [ ] Hand-mutant kill rate on `resolve_bedrock_region` reported as a ticket comment; target 100%.
- [ ] `make lint`, `make typecheck`, and the targeted suites (test_bedrock_provider.py, test_verdict_provenance.py, test_ci_provider_matrix.py) pass; complexity ratchet reports new=0 increased=0; module-size cap respected. Change uploaded to Gerrit for LLM-Review/Verified (votes land post-session; proxy: the change exists on the server with the rebar-ticket trailer).
